OpenMx Algebra of a Diagonal Covariance Matrix

Source: R/mxHelper-sigma-diag-from-ldl-softplus-algebra.R
MxHelperSigmaDiagFromLDLSoftplusAlgebra.Rd

Builds the OpenMx algebra of a diagonal covariance matrix whose diagonal is the softplus of the column vector column, plus \(10^{-8}\), so that it stays positive. The arguments are checked first; the internal version, without checks, is the one other projects copy.

Usage

MxHelperSigmaDiagFromLDLSoftplusAlgebra(column, name)

Arguments

column

Character string. Name of the column vector of unconstrained diagonal elements of \(\boldsymbol{D}\).

name

Character string. Name of the matrix or algebra.

Value

Returns an OpenMx algebra (MxAlgebra) named name.

See also

Other Covariance Matrix Functions: MxHelperInvLDL(), MxHelperInvSoftplus(), MxHelperLDL(), MxHelperSigmaDiagFromLDLMxMatrix(), MxHelperSigmaFixed(), MxHelperSigmaFromLDLFixed(), MxHelperSigmaFromLDLLogAlgebra(), MxHelperSigmaFromLDLMxMatrix(), MxHelperSigmaFromLDLSoftplusAlgebra(), MxHelperSoftplus()

Author

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Examples

MxHelperSigmaDiagFromLDLSoftplusAlgebra(
  column = "sigma_d",
  name = "sigma"
)
#> mxAlgebra 'sigma' 
#> $formula:  vec2diag(((sigma_d + abs(sigma_d))/2) + mxRobustLog(1 + exp(-abs(sigma_d))) + 1e-08) 
#> $result: (not yet computed) <0 x 0 matrix>
#> dimnames: NULL
